# The weekly tick over three repositories. api has a newer Go dependency, web has a newer npm dependency, and tools has nothing newer.
# api and web each get one run and one draft pull request. tools is skipped before any run exists. The report counts the three rows.
# The update creates go.sum and package-lock.json for the first time: the commit must hold both, which only a status check sees.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
maintinit
maintfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_BASE=file://$WORK/remotes
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W44
# mkprojects.sh writes one project file for each repository, with the forge and the test command of the row. A file that a person wrote is kept.
exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/mkprojects.sh $WORK/generated
stdout 'wrote .*/projects/api.star'
grep 'repo = "acme/api"' generated/projects/api.star
grep 'gate = "JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=reports npm test -- --reporters=jest-junit"' generated/projects/web.star
cp person.star generated/projects/web.star
exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/mkprojects.sh $WORK/generated
stderr 'kept .*/projects/web.star: not generated'
grep 'my own' generated/projects/web.star
# The project files of this script are the generated ones: repo and forge, no local source.
grep 'forge = "github"' config/projects/api.star
! grep 'source = "' config/projects/api.star
exec beehavereal check workflow home/.upkeep/bump.star
! stdout .
exec beehavereal check workflow home/.upkeep/report.star
! stdout .

exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
stdout 'item bump-api-2026-W44 finished'
stdout 'item bump-web-2026-W44 finished'
stdout 'item report-2026-W44 finished'

# One run for each repository with news. The skipped repository has no item and no tree work.
exec beehave status
stdout 'item-bump-api-2026-W44-r1\tdone'
stdout 'item-bump-web-2026-W44-r1\tdone'
! stdout 'bump-tools'
grep -count=2 '^update$' calls.log
! grep '^fix' calls.log

# The run log holds one row for each repository.
grep '^2026-W44\tapi\topened\thttps://github.example/acme/pull/1\tdraft pull request\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep '^2026-W44\tweb\topened\thttps://github.example/acme/pull/2\tdraft pull request\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep '^2026-W44\ttools\tskipped\t\tskip: nothing is outdated\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv

# The state holds the fingerprint, the week and the pull request, outside every worktree.
grep '^last_week=2026-W44$' home/.upkeep/state/api.env
grep '^last_pr=https://github.example/acme/pull/1$' home/.upkeep/state/api.env
grep '^last_fp=' home/.upkeep/state/web.env
! exists home/.upkeep/state/tools.env

# The branch reached the remote with the manifest files. The pull request is a draft.
exec git -C remotes/acme/api show --stat upkeep/api-2026-W44
stdout 'go.mod'
stdout 'go.sum'
exec git -C remotes/acme/web show --stat upkeep/web-2026-W44
stdout 'package-lock.json'
grep -count=1 'gh pr create --draft --head upkeep/api-2026-W44 --base main' gh.log
grep -count=1 'gh pr create --draft --head upkeep/web-2026-W44 --base main' gh.log
! grep 'upkeep/tools' gh.log

# The report counts the rows and names the pull requests that wait for review.
grep '3 repositories listed. 2 opened a pull request, 1 skipped,' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep '^- api: opened, https://github.example/acme/pull/1' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep '^- tools: skipped' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep '^- web: https://github.example/acme/pull/2, opened in 2026-W44' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
exec beehave status
stdout 'item-report-2026-W44-r1\tdone'

# A second tick in the same week costs nothing: every row says it already ran or has nothing to do.
exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
grep -count=1 'gh pr create --draft --head upkeep/api-2026-W44' gh.log
grep '^2026-W44\tapi\tskipped\t\tskip: already ran in 2026-W44\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv


# The repeat guard of pr.sh: a second call for one branch finds the first pull request and opens none.
exec git clone -q remotes/acme/api again
exec sh -c 'cd again && echo body | sh ../home/.upkeep/scripts/pr.sh api 2026-W50 fp main'
exec sh -c 'cd again && echo body | sh ../home/.upkeep/scripts/pr.sh api 2026-W50 fp main'
grep -count=1 'gh pr create --draft --head upkeep/api-2026-W50' gh.log
grep -count=2 'gh pr list --head upkeep/api-2026-W50' gh.log

-- person.star --
# my own file
project(repo = "acme/web", forge = "github")
-- fixtures/go-api.json --
{"Path":"acme/api","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0","Update":{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.3.0"}}
-- fixtures/go-tools.json --
{"Path":"acme/tools","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0"}
-- fixtures/npm.json --
{"left-pad":{"current":"1.0.0","wanted":"1.3.0","latest":"1.3.0"}}
